name: [ADMIN ABUSE] Case Haven
desc:
🎁 Open cases, collect rare skins, upgrade your luck, unlock new zones, and build the ultimate inventory! Trade up, flex your pulls, and chase that golden drop. ✨

In Case Haven you level up by opening cases and upgrading your character!
Level up to unlock cooler, more expensive items!

Drop Chances:

🔵 4 in 5 for a blue (79.92%)
🟣 1 in 6 for a purple (15.98%)
🌸 1 in 31 for a pink (3.2%)
🔴 1 in 156 for a red (0.64%)
🟡 1 in 385 for a gold (0.26%)

Thanks for playing!
